eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 6:41 PM on AUG 20, 2021 Effective until 9:41 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Plumas County Sheriffs Office with a new mandatory evacuation order for Beckwourth Genesee Rd south of Antelope Lake Rd to Grizzly Ridge and North of Argentine Lookout and South of Beckwourth Genesee Rd to the NW side of Lake Davis along Grizzly Ridge to the west and including the Walker Mine
